name: Like Two
source:
Yo. I'm UL85A2, codename "Like Two."
I'm a British-made assault rifle.
My predecessor, the UL85A1, was pretty much a piece of junk, so they gave me a massive overhaul and that's how I came to be.
Some guys complain I'm heavy, but that's just small fry talk.
My performance is top-notch, so make sure you handle me properly.
